title: GoodTimesWithScar Reborn
description: Adds GTWS's log textures but with support for newer wood types with stripped variants!
body:
Adds GTWS's log textures but with support for newer wood types with stripped variants!

More textures to come from his old modpack.

Thanks to GoodTimesWithScar for a great childhood, check out his original texture pack videos!

Videos by GTWS https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oe2MgDTe77w, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NSSIvXbIjXk He really inspired me to make my childhood come to the present through this texture pack!

This resource pack is meant for 1.21-1.21.11 I may update it to most Minecraft Versions which won't be too hard!
